name: gitleaks
title: gitleaks
description: Finds secrets - API keys, tokens, passwords, private keys - in files and in the whole history of git repositories with gitleaks 8.30 and its built-in rules (or your .toml rules). Findings name rule, file, line, commit, author and date; secrets are redacted in the answer unless asked otherwise. Paths are read from the folder mounted at /work. No network.
license: MIT (MCP server, axross-mcp-hub; gitleaks) AND GPL-2.0 (git, Debian package)

mounts.description: The folder or repository to scan (read-only is enough)

notes: A scanned repository's own git configuration cannot make git run programs: textconv and external diff drivers, fsmonitor and hooks are switched off for every git call.
